summary: Iter10 covered email auth (register/login), guest device_id persistence, admin-via-email-form, and premium-gated pattern themes. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed — register success + duplicate/short-password/admin-email-blocked validations, login success+401 paths + admin shortcut, /auth/guest with same device_id returns same user_id (different sessions), different device_ids yield different users, no-body back-compat works, /auth/me + /api/ai/tool both authenticated via returned session_token. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): login screen shows '13 AI writing tools' subtitle (no 16, no 'Emergent' text), all 8 testIDs present (email/password/submit/switch/google/facebook/apple/guest); toggle to Create new account reveals NAME field; Facebook & Apple taps show 'coming soon' info message and do NOT navigate; full signup flow with unique email reaches /setup → home tabs; signin with testuser@keymind.app/testpass123 succeeds; admin sign-in via the SAME email/password form (himthegreat@gmail.com / aa$fufm2q) works and unlocks premium; Settings tab shows BACKGROUND PATTERN section with PREMIUM tag and 5 swatches (classic/dots/grid/stripes/waves); FREE users (testuser + guest) tapping a locked pattern routes to /pricing; ADMIN tapping Dots applies the pattern with no nav and [data-testid=pattern-background] renders behind both Settings AND Write screens; regression — Write shows 'Choose a tool · 13 tools', Chat tab has dictate-lang-chip, History tab loads. Minor copy inconsistency: /pricing screen still says 'All 14 writing tools + Vocab' while everywhere else it's 13.

issues: Bullet copy reads 'All 14 writing tools + Vocab' but rest of app standardised on 13 AI writing tools — update to '13' for consistency.

action_items: Update /app/frontend/app/pricing.tsx feature bullet text from 'All 14 writing tools + Vocab' to '13 writing tools' (or current count) so it matches the login-screen and Write-tab copy.
Optional: hide passlib bcrypt warning by pinning bcrypt==4.0.1 or using passlib's argon2 — non-blocking, only logs at server startup.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth routes (server.py 374-538) are clean: bcrypt hashing via passlib, hmac.compare_digest for admin password, sessions persisted with 30d expiry, admin shortcut routed via /auth/login to /auth/admin avoids duplication.

Guest device_id reuse uses a unique find on {guest_device_id, is_guest:true}; consider adding a partial unique index on guest_device_id to prevent race-condition duplicates under heavy parallel guest taps (low risk in practice).
PatternBackground.tsx + ThemeContext.tsx are minimal and well-scoped; pattern is rendered absolute-fill, pointerEvents='none' so it never intercepts taps. testID='pattern-background' set correctly.
settings.tsx pickPattern correctly gates non-classic patterns on isPremium and routes to /pricing — matches spec exactly.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a disposable user via /api/auth/register (prefixed test_iter10_/sess_/ui_test_) and disposable guests with TEST_DEV_ device_ids. No production-impacting data modified; testuser@keymind.app reused for login/signin assertions only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Onboarding flow: SKIP → login → setup-finish-btn → tabs (Write/Chat/History/Settings). Login testIDs: login-{email,password,name,submit,switch-mode,google,facebook,apple,guest}-btn / -input. Pattern testIDs: settings-pattern-{classic|dots|grid|stripes|waves} + pattern-background (full-bleed overlay). Admin auth: regular /auth/login form accepts himthegreat@gmail.com / aa$fufm2q and returns is_admin+is_premium true. Guest device_id contract: same device_id ⇒ same user_id, fresh session_token each call. Note: chat-response-lang-chip from iter9 is no longer present in code — not in current scope but worth noting if regression matters.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found in scope. The only finding is a stale '14 writing tools' string on /pricing, a cosmetic copy lag from a prior iteration count change.
